CustomField.label: Customer Code
CustomField.description:
★R8 SEIM_INVITEE.CUST_CD, and the field R7 routes the approval chain on. On the invitee rather than the attendee, correcting the R7 draft: a customer code follows the employer, and an attendee who changes jobs would otherwise carry a code that is quietly wrong from that day on.
A code, not a relationship. Snapshotted from the Account at add time so that reading it needs no grant on Account and no dereference at approval time — the chain lookup is a string comparison against Approval_Route__c.Cust_Cd__c.
WHICH ACCOUNT FIELD IT COMES FROM IS AN ASSUMPTION: InviteeSelectorController reads the standard Account.AccountNumber, because that is the field every org has and it is the one that means "customer account number". If this org keeps its customer code somewhere else, that is one line in that class and a note in the post-deploy checklist, not a redesign.
